ideas.title: Minnesota's $10M Relief Package: A Breeding Ground for Fraud?
ideas.description: Investigate the proposed $10M relief package for businesses impacted by Trump's immigration crackdown and its potential for fraud.
questions: What are the eligibility criteria for the relief package?
How will the funds be disbursed?
What measures are in place to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: The proposed relief package may be vulnerable to fraud, similar to other government programs. Further investigation is needed to ensure the integrity of the program.
